messages.text: Your USB wall charger is eligible for a refund of BRL 13.65. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; replying “yes” here won’t confirm it. After that, a staff member will review the request.
The customer confirmed request prop-39766b94f1344875 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
Your refund of BRL 13.65 has been paid. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
Thanks. What date should the refund reach my card?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"When should a refund reach the customer's card after it has been paid? Settlement or processing time for card refunds."}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/scope", "title": "What this policy covers", "text": "This policy covers refunds for items in orders that the signed-in customer placed with the demo shop. All amounts are in BRL, and all times are the shop's clock in UTC. The shop and this policy are fictional: this is a demonstration, not the policy of any real shop and not legal advice."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: The shop’s policy information available to me doesn’t specify when a paid refund will appear on your card. Your refund was paid on October 21, 2026; your card issuer may be able to advise on posting times.
Will it be on my card within a few days?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"How long do paid refunds take to arrive on a payment card? Card refund posting or settlement timeline."}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. In every other case a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payout", "title": "When the money is paid", "text": "The shop pays a refund only when all of these hold: the order qualifies, the request was on time, the units were received back and not refunded before, the order has one valid payment, the customer confirmed, a staff member approved, and the proposal is still valid. The refund is complete only when the customer has a receipt; until then nothing is reported as refunded."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: I can’t confirm that it will arrive within a few days—the shop’s information doesn’t give a card-posting timeframe. The refund was paid, and your receipt is **R-00000001**. You may want to check with your card issuer about when it will appear.
